purpose: Float HUD-style key caps and icon cells over world objects as billboards, drawn with the combat HUD palette.
state_owner: Badge look and key-press animation timing

world_badge_v1.key: key(label: String, height := 0.0) -> Node3D; a key cap that keeps playing a press animation while visible
world_badge_v1.icon: icon(texture: Texture2D, region: Rect2, tint: Color, height := 0.0) -> Node3D; an atlas icon in a panel cell; empty region uses the whole texture
world_badge_v1.set_label: set_label(label: String) -> void on a key badge
world_badge_v1.visibility: Hidden badges stop rendering; showing one renders it again.
